content.short: SphereOne offers a secure one-click checkout to use crypto across multiple blockchains.
content.description: Crypto payments today are hampered by two core issues: moving assets across different blockchains is slow and complex, and the current cross-chain infrastructure is insecure, with about $1B in losses from hacked bridges. SphereOne addresses these challenges by enabling fast on- and off-ramps for any cryptocurrency or fiat currency in under ten seconds. The platform also employs two-factor authentication alongside other advanced security measures to help ensure that each transaction remains secure.
